title: Clinical trial to see the effect and safety of botulinum toxin type A with doses adapted to patients with severe spasticity
official: Clinical trial on the effectiveness and safety of botulinum toxin type A (incobotulinumtoxin) in doses adapted to the individual needs of patients with severe spasticity
summary:
Main objective: To determine the efficacy and safety of the administration of IncobotulinumtoxinA at individualized doses, selected based on the individual needs of patients (spasticity
patterns) with severe spasticity and involvement of the upper and lower limbs.

interventions.name: XEOMIN 50 unidades polvo para solución inyectable

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients older than 18 years
2. with a diagnosis of severe multifocal spasticity of the upper and lower limbs due to acquired brain damage
3. Who need treatment with IncobotulinumtoxinA at a dose equal to or greater than 800U
4. That they agree to participate in the study and sign the informed consent
5. With pain assessment data (VAS scale), muscle tone (Asworth scale), and Barthel scale during the follow-up evaluation.
6. No contraindications for treatment with botulinum toxin
Exclusion criteria:
1. Patients with severe systemic diseases and active infection
2. Pregnant patients or under lactating period.
